title: The Unlucky Spoon
trend: Baseball postseason (October 2026, MLB League Championship Series this week) — TikTok/Instagram Reels 'POV: your first playoff game with his superstitious family' superstition-rules skits at home watch parties

description:
Rule one: don't use the front door. Rule two: never wash the jersey. Rule three: hold the spoon.
One playoff night, three rules, and a very lucky nacho.

lines.text: Priya. Welcome to your first playoff game with this family. Please. Do not touch anything.
Hi! I brought dip.
Put the dip down. Slowly. Which door did you walk in through?
The front door?
Unbelievable. We have lost three games to the front door.
Good evening. I am the foul ball. He caught me in nineteen ninety eight. With his face.
With my hands. Near my face.
Don't touch the ball. He'll make you sit with it.
Your dog talks?
Only during the playoffs. It's a superstition.
Rule one. Everyone sits exactly where they sat when we won game two.
I wasn't here for game two.
Then you were in the hallway. Go stand in the hallway.
Can I at least see the screen from the hallway?
Through the mirror. Backwards. That's how the luck likes it.
I've been on this cushion for nine days. I am part of the couch now.
He is a throw pillow with opinions.
Rule two. The jersey does not get washed during October.
I can smell it from the cushion. And I lick things for fun.
Benny, there's a nacho stuck to your number seven.
That nacho was there for the double play. That nacho stays.
Okay. Do I get a lucky thing?
You get the unlucky spoon. Hold it. It absorbs the bad luck.
This is a regular spoon.
It was. Then it stirred the chili during the rain delay.
We don't speak of the rain delay.
I speak of it. Constantly. To myself. In the cabinet.
Rule three. Nobody uses the bathroom while we have runners on base.
What if it's an emergency?
Then you go next door. Their team got knocked out. They have luck to spare.
I went in their yard in the fourth inning. We scored twice.
Good boy. Hero. Somebody put that dog on a stamp.
Here it comes. Bottom of the eighth. Everybody do the rally face.
Rally face!
What is the rally face?
You look worried, but in a confident way. Like a dad at a water park.
Wait. Benny. Why does the corner of the screen say last October?
No it doesn't.
It does. In tiny letters. Right under the pitcher.
Oh dear. She can read.
Fine. I don't watch the real game. I watch last year's win. It puts luck in the room.
So where is the real game?
Kitchen radio. I've been listening the whole time. With my big ears.
And?
Ninth inning. Two outs. And somebody left the front door open.
Nobody move! Nobody breathe! Priya, hold up the spoon!
I'm holding the spoon!
There's the pitch. Big swing. And it is. Gone. We win.
We won! Because of the open door! And the spoon! And the new girl!
I didn't do anything.
Exactly. You did nothing perfectly. You're coming to every game. Forever. Holding that spoon.
Welcome to the family, dear. Nobody leaves. I've been here since nineteen ninety eight.
And somebody, please, wash that jersey.
